info.name: Daggerheart API Collection
info.description:
Auto-generated comprehensive API collection for the Daggerheart TTRPG character management application. This collection includes all major endpoints for authentication, user management, admin operations, and Daggerheart game resources (cards, classes, domains, equipment, etc.).

IMPORTANT: Most endpoints require authentication via httpOnly cookie. After logging in, the cookie will be automatically set and used for subsequent requests.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: User authentication endpoints including registration, login, and logout

request.description: Register a new user account. Username must be 3-100 characters with letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens. Password must be 8-100 characters.
Login with username or email. Sets an httpOnly authentication cookie for subsequent requests.
Logout current user, revoke token, and clear authentication cookie. Requires authentication.

item.name: Get Login History by User ID

request.description: Get login attempts for a specific user. Requires OWNER or ADMIN role.

item.name: Get Login History by IP Address

request.description: Get login attempts for a specific IP address. Requires OWNER or ADMIN role.
Ban a user account. Invalidates all tokens. Requires OWNER, ADMIN, or MODERATOR role with higher rank than target user.
Unban a user account. Requires OWNER, ADMIN, or MODERATOR role with higher rank than target user.
Change a user's role. Valid roles: USER, MODERATOR, ADMIN, OWNER. Invalidates all user tokens. Requires OWNER role.
